citations.title: Malachyte: Interview With Co-Founder And CEO Sidd Motwani About Behavior Intelligence For E-Commerce
excerpts: _Unlike most AI solutions, we are not using a large language model. We’re not predicting the next word in a sentence. We’re using vector AI to predict the next product a shopper wants from real-time behavior._ _We leverage our own proprietary two-headed transformer. One head is a slower base model that learns a shopper’s general taste over time. The other fine-tunes continuously based on what they’re doing in this exact session._

citations.title: Technology | Malachyte
excerpts: Vector AI is the engine behind Malachyte. Instead of sorting shoppers into broad segments or waiting for batch models that process overnight, it represents each shopper as a Vector AI profile — a live, evolving snapshot of behavior and intent.

basis.reasoning: The CEO says Malachyte uses its own proprietary two-headed transformer and does not use an LLM; the company calls its engine Vector AI. This identifies its proprietary model rather than an external provider.
